items.headline: Seagate fell sharply after management comments at a JPMorgan conference raised concerns it may not expand manufacturing fast enough to keep up with demand
Seagate shares were also pressured by a broader AI-memory selloff tied to reports that SK Hynix is slowing HBM expansion
Citigroup raised its price target on Seagate and Wells Fargo upgraded the stock, reflecting continued bullish analyst sentiment
